title: Canon of the Falling Thunder
summary: A canon of thunder brought down from a height on a whole field of foes, ending in a ruinous cataclysm.

title: Treatise of the Ruinous Core
summary: A treatise on the destructive thunder that a formed core can pour out, from raging peals to a core cataclysm.

title: Book of the Sovereign Lightning
summary: A book of lightning ruled as a sovereign rules, with decrees of ruin and an unmaking thunder.
